17:23-17:49 - The second buck was sizeable. Also came from the left behind me. I heard him rubbing a tree (then saw the tree shaking) well before I saw him. Heard him vocalizing for a long time. Saw him for a while but never got a shot. Est. 8pt...tall and wide but thin.

Buck came up from behind left shoulder on same side of the creek as me.  It was less than 10yds and I spooked it trying to get into position.  It ran behind me and circled around and we stared at each other for a while before it ran off directly behind the stand.

Buck showed up at the corn pile while I had my head down after I had pissed right off of the stand... / He was close (10yds) and we stared at each other a while.  He bobbed his head and stomped.  I eventually got a shot over a limb that was in the way.  3 point rack
Watched a small buck at 30yds.  Then another buck at dusk.  Shot/hit the buck at dusk.  Broke bolt, no harvest.

Heard deer walking well before sunrise.  Full moon allowed me to see it come up from behind my right shoulder, into top corner of ridge, and down the path.  All before sunrise.
Saw what I thought was a doe (turned out to be a spike, but low light and tiny antlers) walk from the swamp to the bail blind field.  Could have shot, glad I didn't.

Buck came up from behind right shoulder (from pond) into the trail I had just walked to the stand on 2 hours earlier. / He did not look interested in entering the field, shot him as he was heading back into the woods behind the stand.  Ran/stumbled down the hill to the pond.  NOTE: I will not hunt up top alone ever again.
